title: Day of the Djinn
author: paperyowl
description:
As you're forced out of the comfort of your home by an ancient curse, you'll discover new things about old places, and perhaps even yourself. Meet a smattering of figures with more to them than meets the eye, learn about your homeland's dubious past, and open new doors. Defy your fate.

Day of the Djinn is a medium-length game with a few puzzles that should take 1-2 hours. Seven endings- but what matters is the journey and the path you choose to walk.
